visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a modern office studio with a gray textured wall featuring the logo 'THE DODO MEN'. A woman (Jeannie) in a white tank top and black pants stands at a counter, gesturing enthusiastically while three colleagues stand behind her in the background. (2) Jeannie presents a large, oversized leopard-print tote bag on the table. She leans into the bag with an excited expression while a male colleague in a green t-shirt and glasses watches from the side. (3) She pulls out a light blue plastic washbasin. She demonstrates its use by mimicking scooping water and washing her face, while her colleagues laugh and react to her physical performance. (4) Jeannie retrieves a large metal ladle from the bag and holds it up proudly. (5) There is a sudden cut to a bright outdoor beach with white sand and clear water, where a man in a black jacket is physically using the same metal ladle to dig a hole in the sand. (6) Back in the studio, a woman (Annie) in a blue shirt presents a white volleyball with a red handprint face drawn on it, mimicking the character 'Wilson' from a movie. (7) A man (Willy) in a dark grey t-shirt presents a long bamboo butterfly net and a roll of silver duct tape, demonstrating how to fix the net. (8) A woman (Penny) is seen in a different room with a white door, holding up a large, uninflated white plastic sheet which is a unicorn-shaped inflatable boat with rainbow accents. (9) A woman (Winnie) with long dark hair and headphones around her neck presents a green box of Quaker 5X Ginseng drink. She holds the box close to her chest and speaks directly to the camera. (10) The final scene shows the whole group gathered around the product, smiling, giving thumbs-up gestures, and making peace signs toward the lens as the camera zooms out slightly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, energetic electronic pop BGM begins with a sharp synthesizer lead. A female speaker introduces the topic with rapid speech and high arousal. A 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the visual title card. (2) Vocal intensity increases as Jeannie describes the leopard bag, accompanied by audible background laughter from the crew. The BGM maintains a consistent four-on-the-floor beat. (3) A 'ding' SFX sounds as the blue basin is presented. The speaker's pitch rises during the demonstration of face washing. (4) A short 'impact' SFX triggers when the ladle is pulled out. The BGM continues uninterrupted as several female voices laugh simultaneously. (5) As the scene cuts to the beach, a faint ambient wind sound is mixed under the primary voiceover. A percussive 'thud' sound mimics the ladle hitting the sand. (6) A 'bubble pop' SFX introduces the volleyball. Annie's voice is cheerful with a melodic rising intonation. (7) A mechanical 'rip' or 'crackle' sound effect accompanies the presentation of the duct tape. Willy's voice is professional but playful. (8) A 'sparkle' SFX plays as the unicorn boat is revealed. The background noise floor remains clean studio silence. (9) Winnie presents the Quaker product with a clear, enunciated broadcasting tone. The BGM volume slightly dips to prioritize the product description. (10) The audio concludes with a group shout and a final rhythmic stinger that fades with a reverb tail.
